hospitalWelcome: Welcome to the hospital. What brings you in today?

tiles.label: 3 - MODERATE

tiles.label: 5 - DISTRACTING

tiles.spokenText: My head hurts a lot now.

tiles.label: ARM HURTS BAD
tiles.spokenText: My right arm hurts bad, can't move it.

tiles.label: LEGS HURT BAD
tiles.spokenText: Legs hurt bad when try move.

tiles.label: HOW LONG
tiles.spokenText: How long does it take? When done?

tiles.label: WHEN PT START?

tiles.spokenText: My arm is weak, can't move it.

tiles.label: NO ARM MOVE
tiles.spokenText: I can't move my right arm at all.

tiles.spokenText: Will my arm stay weak forever?

tiles.label: NO MOVEMENT
tiles.spokenText: Right arm has no movement at all.

tiles.spokenText: Will my arm ever move again? I'm scared.

tiles.label: ARM NUMB
tiles.spokenText: My arm feels completely numb, no feeling.

tiles.label: NO ARM MOVE
tiles.spokenText: I can't move my arm at all.

tiles.label: SCARED FOREVER
tiles.spokenText: Is the numbness going to be permanent?

tiles.label: GET BETTER?
tiles.spokenText: Will my arm ever get better?

tiles.label: ARM WEAK TOO
tiles.spokenText: My arm is weak too, can't lift it.

tiles.label: SCARED TO STAND
tiles.spokenText: I'm scared I'll fall if I stand.

tiles.label: RIGHT LEG NUMB
tiles.spokenText: My right leg feels completely numb and won't move.

tiles.label: SCARED FALL
tiles.spokenText: I'm scared I'll fall if I try to walk without help.

tiles.label: PT WHEN START?
tiles.spokenText: When will physical therapy start to help me walk?

tiles.label: ARM WEAK TOO
tiles.spokenText: My right arm is also weak, not just the leg.

tiles.label: LEGS TOO WEAK
tiles.spokenText: My legs are too weak to get up.

tiles.label: ARM NUMB, LEG TOO
tiles.spokenText: Yes, right arm feels completely numb and heavy, left leg won't move either—terrifying, like it's not mine.

tiles.label: WHAT MONITORS?
tiles.spokenText: What are the beeping machines? They scare me.

tiles.label: SCAN SAFE? DIZZY
tiles.spokenText: CT dye hurt? Head spinning bad since fall at work—boss firing me if late tomorrow.

tiles.label: THROAT HURT. WALK SOON?
tiles.spokenText: Throat scratchy swallowing hard—PT help? Retired teacher, just want garden again, not wheelchair.

tiles.label: HEAD HURTS MORE
tiles.spokenText: My head hurts more with the tPA.

tiles.label: NO ARM MOVE
tiles.spokenText: Can't move my arm at all.

tiles.label: SCARED FALL DOWN
tiles.spokenText: Scared I'll fall trying to stand.

tiles.label: WHAT TREATMENT?
tiles.spokenText: What treatment options do I have?

tiles.label: KIDS HERE?
tiles.spokenText: When can my kids come visit?

tiles.label: WANT FAMILY HERE
tiles.spokenText: The noise scares me, I want my family to calm me.

tiles.label: YES SEDATIVE PLEASE
tiles.spokenText: Yes, give me the sedative please.

tiles.label: NO NO SEDATIVE
tiles.spokenText: No, I don't want any sedative.

tiles.label: CALL MY FAMILY
tiles.spokenText: Can you call my family now?

tiles.label: FAMILY HELP TOILET
tiles.spokenText: Call my family to help me.

tiles.label: CALL MY FAMILY
tiles.spokenText: Can you call my family? I want them here.

tiles.spokenText: Can you call my family please?

tiles.label: WANT FAMILY
tiles.spokenText: I want my family here now.

tiles.label: SCARED OF NEEDLE
tiles.spokenText: Scared of the needle for tPA.

tiles.label: WANT FAMILY HERE
tiles.spokenText: I want my family to come now.

tiles.label: KIDS WAITING HOME
tiles.spokenText: My toddler's alone with the sitter—please call my husband now, what if I can't hug her because of this dead arm?

tiles.label: CALL MY PRIEST
tiles.spokenText: Maybe two hours back, this feels like God's test—can you call my priest?

tiles.label: PRIEST NOW! ARM 9
tiles.spokenText: Please priest before scan—arm's dead weight, pain 9, like fire from heaven testing me.
